name: The Creative
text: The Creative brings sublime success, furthering through perseverance.
tuan: Great indeed is the sublimity of the Creative, to which all beings owe their beginning and which permeates all heaven. The clouds pass and the rain falls, and all individual beings flow into their forms. Great is the brilliance of the Creative, the six lines beginning and ending with the dragon's power. The way of the Creative is change and transformation, each receiving its true nature and destiny. In union and harmony they preserve great peace; this is the advantage of perseverance. The sage appears above and all under heaven are glad.
daxiang: The movement of heaven is full of power, thus the superior person makes himself strong and untiring.

name: The Receptive
text: The Receptive brings sublime success, furthering through the perseverance of a mare. If the superior person undertakes something and tries to lead, he goes astray; but if he follows, he finds guidance. It is favorable to find friends in the west and south, to forego friends in the east and north. Quiet perseverance brings good fortune.
tuan: Complete indeed is the sublimity of the Receptive; all things owe to it their birth. The Receptive in its vastness carries all things, and its virtue is without limit. It embraces all in its breadth, and all beings thrive. The mare belongs to the earth; it travels the earth without bound, and its yielding nature is good in perseverance. When the superior person goes forth, at first he goes astray and loses the way; but if he follows, he gains guidance and finds what is regular. To find friends in the west and south means to act with one's kind. To forego friends in the east and north means that finally there is celebration. The good fortune of quiet perseverance corresponds to the boundlessness of the earth.
daxiang: The power of the earth is in its receptivity; thus the superior person carries others with a broad heart.

name: Difficulty at the Beginning
text: Difficulty at the Beginning brings supreme success, furthering through perseverance. Nothing should be undertaken, it furthers to appoint helpers.
tuan: Difficulty at the Beginning: the firm and the yielding come together and difficulty is born. Movement amidst danger brings great success through perseverance. Thunder and rain fill the air, bringing all to fullness; heaven creates the primitive state, and it is fitting to appoint helpers, though one remains not at peace.
daxiang: Clouds and thunder: Difficulty at the Beginning. The superior person brings order out of chaos.

name: Youthful Folly
text: Youthful Folly has success. It is not I who seek the young fool; the young fool seeks me. At the first oracle I inform him. If he asks two or three times, it is importunity. If he importunes, I give him no information. Perseverance furthers.
tuan: Youthful Folly: below the mountain is danger, danger and stillness make Youthful Folly. Youthful Folly brings success because it is the time to bring order through success. It is not I who seek the young fool; the young fool seeks me because the will responds. At the first oracle I inform him because the firm is in the middle. If he asks two or three times, it is importunity. If he importunes, I give him no information because he shows lack of respect for Youthful Folly. Youthful Folly serves to nurture what is correct, and this is the work of the sage.
daxiang: A spring flows out of the mountain: the image of Youthful Folly. Thus the superior person fosters his character by thoroughness in all that is small.

name: Waiting
text: Waiting. If you are sincere, you have light and success. Perseverance brings good fortune. It furthers one to cross the great water.
tuan: Waiting means nourishment. Danger lies ahead; the firm and strong do not fall into it, and thus their purpose is not brought to an end. Waiting with sincerity brings light and success, perseverance brings good fortune, because one is in the place of heaven and acts from the center and correctly. It furthers one to cross the great water, for going forward brings achievement.
daxiang: Clouds rise up to heaven: the image of Waiting. Thus the superior person eats and drinks, feasts and enjoys himself as if there were nothing else to do.

name: Conflict
text: Conflict. You are sincere and are being obstructed. A cautious halt halfway brings good fortune. Going through to the end brings misfortune. It furthers one to see the great person. It does not further one to cross the great water.
tuan: Conflict: above is strength, below is danger. To be in danger yet maintain strength brings conflict. Conflict brings sincerity that is obstructed, caution that halts halfway brings good fortune because the firm comes and gains the center. Going through to the end brings misfortune because conflict cannot be sustained. It furthers one to see the great person because one esteems what is central and correct. It does not further one to cross the great water because one would fall into the abyss.
daxiang: Heaven and water go their opposite ways: the image of Conflict. Thus in all his transactions the superior person carefully considers the beginning.

name: The Army
text: The Army needs perseverance and a strong person. Good fortune without blame.
tuan: The Army means the masses. Perseverance means correctness. One able to make the masses correct may become king. The strong is in the center and responds; it acts in danger yet follows, and thus uses this to bring all under heaven into submission. The people follow it, and where is the blame? Good fortune indeed.
daxiang: In the middle of the earth is water: the image of the Army. Thus the superior person tolerates the people and nourishes the masses.

name: Holding Together
text: Holding Together brings good fortune. Inquire of the oracle once again whether you possess sublimity, constancy, and perseverance; then there is no blame. Those who are uncertain gradually join. Whoever comes too late meets with misfortune.
tuan: Holding Together brings good fortune. Holding Together means help; those below follow and obey. Inquire of the oracle once again whether you possess sublimity, constancy, and perseverance; then there is no blame because of the firmness in the center. Those who are uncertain gradually join because above and below respond. Whoever comes too late meets with misfortune because his way is exhausted.
daxiang: On the earth is water: the image of Holding Together. Thus the kings of antiquity established the myriad states and had friendly relations with the feudal lords.

name: The Taming Power of the Small
text: The Taming Power of the Small has success. Dense clouds, no rain from our western region.
tuan: The Taming Power of the Small: the yielding obtains the central position and above and below respond to it. This is called the Taming Power of the Small. Strength and gentleness; the firm is in the center and its will is carried out, thus bringing success. Dense clouds, no rain, means that it is still going forward. From our western region means that the influence has not yet been exerted.
daxiang: The wind drives across heaven: the image of the Taming Power of the Small. Thus the superior person refines the outward aspect of his nature.

name: Treading
text: Treading on the tail of the tiger. It does not bite the person. Success.
tuan: Treading means treading upon the tail of the tiger. It does not bite the person because of the yielding that responds to the Creative. Treading on the tail of the tiger, it does not bite the person, thus bringing success. The firm is central and correct, treading on the position of the ruler without guilt, shining bright indeed.
daxiang: Heaven above, the lake below: the image of Treading. Thus the superior person discriminates between high and low, and thereby fortifies the thinking of the people.

name: Peace
text: The small departs, the great approaches. Good fortune. Success.
tuan: Peace: the small departs, the great approaches, and good fortune and success come. Thus heaven and earth unite, and all things come into full flower; above and below unite, and their wills are one. Within is the yang, without is the yin; within is strength, without is gentleness; within is the superior person, without is the inferior. The way of the superior person is expanding, while the way of the inferior is shrinking.
daxiang: Heaven and earth unite: the image of Peace. Thus the ruler divides and completes the course of heaven and earth; he furthers and regulates the gifts of heaven and earth, and so aids the people.

name: Standstill
text: Standstill. It is not the person's own fault. The superior person is not favored in a time of standstill; the great departs and the small approaches.
tuan: Standstill: it is not the person's own fault. The superior person is not favored in a time of standstill because the great departs and the small approaches. Thus heaven and earth do not unite, and all things are not brought to full flower; above and below do not unite, and in all the states there is no stable government. Within is the yin, without is the yang; within is gentleness, without is strength; within is the inferior person, without is the superior. The way of the inferior is expanding, while the way of the superior is shrinking.
daxiang: Heaven and earth do not unite: the image of Standstill. Thus the superior person falls back upon his inner worth in order to escape the difficulties. He does not permit himself to be honored with revenue.

name: Fellowship with Men
text: Fellowship with Men in the open. Success. It furthers one to cross the great water. The perseverance of the superior person furthers.
tuan: Fellowship with Men: the yielding occupies the central position and finds correspondence in the Creative. This is called Fellowship with Men. Fellowship with Men in the open: success. It furthers one to cross the great water because the Creative puts it into motion. Clarity with strength, central and correct, and corresponding: this is the correctness of the superior person. Only the superior person is able to unite the wills of all under heaven.
daxiang: Heaven together with fire: the image of Fellowship with Men. Thus the superior person organizes the clans and distinguishes the things.

name: Possession in Great Measure
text: Possession in Great Measure. Supreme success.
tuan: Possession in Great Measure: the yielding obtains the honored central position and above and below respond to it. This is called Possession in Great Measure. Its character is strength and clarity; strength is clear and carries out what is right, responding to heaven and acting in time. Thus there is supreme success.
daxiang: Fire in heaven above: the image of Possession in Great Measure. Thus the superior person curbs evil and furthers good, thereby obeying the benevolent will of heaven.

name: Modesty
text: Modesty creates success. The superior person carries something through.
tuan: Modesty creates success because heaven's way sends down its benefits, and earth's way carries them upward. Heaven's way decreases the full and increases the humble. Earth's way transforms the full and pours into the humble. The way of spirits and gods hurts the full and blesses the humble. The way of humans dislikes the full and loves the humble. Modesty in a high position shines; in a low position it cannot be ignored. Thus the superior person has success.
daxiang: Within the earth there is a mountain: the image of Modesty. Thus the superior person takes from the surplus to fill the deficiency, weighing and distributing things evenly.

name: Enthusiasm
text: Enthusiasm. It furthers one to install helpers and to set armies marching.
tuan: Enthusiasm: the firm responds and the will is carried out. Acting in accordance with the time is Enthusiasm. Enthusiasm that acts in accordance with the time is thus in harmony with heaven and earth. How much more will it be favorable to install helpers and set armies marching! Heaven and earth acting in accordance with the time, thus the sun and moon do not err, and the four seasons do not deviate. The sage acts in accordance with the time, and thus penalties are clear and the people submit. The time of Enthusiasm is great indeed!
daxiang: Thunder comes resounding out of the earth: the image of Enthusiasm. Thus the ancient kings made music in order to honor merit, and offered it with splendor to the Supreme Deity, thereby associating themselves with their ancestors.

name: Following
text: Following has supreme success. Perseverance furthers. No blame.
tuan: Following: the firm comes and places itself under the yielding. Action with joy is Following. Great success and perseverance without blame, and all under heaven follow the time. Following the time is great indeed!
daxiang: Thunder in the middle of the lake: the image of Following. Thus the superior person at evening turns inward for rest and recuperation.

name: Work on What Has Been Spoiled
text: Work on What Has Been Spoiled has supreme success. It furthers one to cross the great water. Before the starting point, three days. After the starting point, three days.
tuan: Work on What Has Been Spoiled: the firm is above and the yielding below; gentle and still, this is Work on What Has Been Spoiled. Work on What Has Been Spoiled brings supreme success, and all under heaven are well ordered. It furthers one to cross the great water because there is something to do. Before the starting point, three days; after the starting point, three days: finally there is a beginning, and heaven's way operates thus.
daxiang: The wind blows low on the mountain: the image of Work on What Has Been Spoiled. Thus the superior person arouses the people and strengthens their spirit.

name: Approach
text: Approach has supreme success. Perseverance furthers. When the eighth month comes, there will be misfortune.
tuan: Approach: the firm is growing and extending. Joy and gentleness; the firm is central and responds. This brings great success through perseverance because it accords with the way of heaven. When the eighth month comes, there will be misfortune because what is full gradually wanes.
daxiang: Above the lake is the earth: the image of Approach. Thus the superior person is inexhaustible in his will to teach, and his openness knows no bounds in tolerating and protecting the people.

name: Contemplation
text: Contemplation. The ablution has been made, but not yet the offering. Full of trust they look up to him.
tuan: The great contemplate above; gentle and yielding, central and correct, they contemplate all under heaven. Contemplation: the ablution has been made, but not yet the offering. With trust they look down because below they look up and are transformed. Contemplating the spiritual way of heaven, the four seasons proceed without error. The sage contemplates the spiritual way and thereby sets all under heaven at peace.
daxiang: The wind blows over the earth: the image of Contemplation. Thus the ancient kings visited the regions of the world, contemplated the people, and set up education.

name: Biting Through
text: Biting Through has success. It is favorable to let justice be administered.
tuan: In the mouth there is something, hence comes Biting Through. Biting Through brings success because the firm and yielding are divided, action brings clarity, thunder and lightning unite and bring clarity. The yielding occupies the central position and goes upward; although it is not in its proper place, it is favorable to let justice be administered.
daxiang: Thunder and lightning: the image of Biting Through. Thus the kings of former times made firm the laws through clearly defined penalties.

name: Grace
text: Grace has success. In small matters it is favorable to undertake something.
tuan: Grace brings success because the yielding comes and adorns the firm. When the firm goes up and adorns the yielding, there is small success in what is undertaken. This is the pattern of heaven. Clear pattern with stillness: this is the pattern of humans. Contemplating the pattern of heaven, we examine the changes of the seasons. Contemplating the pattern of humans, we transform and perfect all under heaven.
daxiang: Fire at the foot of the mountain: the image of Grace. Thus the superior person brings order to the abundance of things but does not sit in judgment on lawsuits.

name: Splitting Apart
text: Splitting Apart. It does not further one to go anywhere.
tuan: Splitting Apart means ruin. The yielding changes the firm. It does not further one to go anywhere because the inferior are growing. Gentleness and stillness, observing the signs: the superior person esteems the waxing and waning, fullness and emptiness, because they are the way of heaven.
daxiang: The mountain rests on the earth: the image of Splitting Apart. Thus those above secure their houses by kindness to those below.

name: Return
text: Return. Success. Going out and coming in without harm. Friends come without blame. To return to one's own way is the way of seven days. It furthers one to have somewhere to go.
tuan: Return brings success because the firm returns. Movement and gentleness, going out and coming in without harm; friends come without blame because they return to the way. To return to one's own way is the way of seven days: this is the movement of heaven. It furthers one to have somewhere to go because the firm is growing. Return shows the heart of heaven and earth.
daxiang: Thunder within the earth: the image of Return. Thus the ancient kings closed the passes at the time of solstice. The merchants did not travel, and the superior person did not inspect the regions.

name: Innocence
text: Innocence. Supreme success. Perseverance furthers. If someone is not as he should be, he has misfortune, and it does not further him to undertake anything.
tuan: Innocence: the firm comes from outside and becomes the ruler within. Movement and strength, the firm in the middle and responding, brings supreme success and perseverance because it is the mandate of heaven. If someone is not as he should be, he has misfortune, and it does not further him to undertake anything. Where can the one who is not innocent go? Heaven's mandate does not protect him; how can he undertake anything?
daxiang: Under heaven thunder rolls: all things attain the natural state of innocence. Thus the ancient kings, in accord with the time, nourished all beings to full growth.

name: The Taming Power of the Great
text: The Taming Power of the Great. Perseverance furthers. Not eating at home brings good fortune. It furthers one to cross the great water.
tuan: The Taming Power of the Great: strength, steadfastness, brightness, and shining virtue, daily renewing its virtue. The firm ascends and honors the worthy. Being able to stop strength is great correctness. Not eating at home brings good fortune because it nourishes the worthy. It furthers one to cross the great water because it responds to heaven.
daxiang: Heaven within the mountain: the image of the Taming Power of the Great. Thus the superior person acquires profound knowledge of former words and deeds, in order to accumulate his virtue.

name: The Corners of the Mouth
text: The Corners of the Mouth. Perseverance brings good fortune. Look not to the corners of the mouth for nourishment, but seek it for yourself.
tuan: The Corners of the Mouth brings good fortune because perseverance in nourishment is correct. Looking not to the corners of the mouth for nourishment means contemplating how one nourishes himself. Seeking it for yourself means observing what one takes in as nourishment. Heaven and earth nourish all things; the sage nourishes the worthy and thereby reaches all the people. The time of the Corners of the Mouth is great indeed!
daxiang: Thunder at the foot of the mountain: the image of the Corners of the Mouth. Thus the superior person is careful with his words and moderate in eating and drinking.

name: Preponderance of the Great
text: Preponderance of the Great. The ridgepole sags to the breaking point. It furthers one to undertake something. Success.
tuan: Preponderance of the Great means greatness in excess. The ridgepole sags because the beginning and end are weak. The firm passes through the middle, and gentleness and joy act; undertaking something brings success. Great indeed is the time of Preponderance of the Great!
daxiang: The lake rises above the wood: the image of Preponderance of the Great. Thus the superior person stands alone without fear, and leaves the world without regret.

name: The Abysmal
text: The Abysmal repeated. If you are sincere, you have success in your heart, and whatever you do succeeds.
tuan: The Abysmal repeated: this is twofold danger. Water flows on and does not fill up; acting in danger does not lose one's sincerity. You have success in your heart because the firm is in the middle. Whatever you do succeeds: going forward brings achievement. Heaven's danger is that we cannot ascend; earth's danger is mountains, rivers, hills, and heights. The kings and princes make use of danger to protect their regions. The use of danger is great indeed!
daxiang: Water flows on uninterruptedly and reaches its goal: the image of the Abysmal repeated. Thus the superior person practices constant virtue and continues his teaching without cease.

name: The Clinging
text: The Clinging. Perseverance furthers. It brings success to nurture the cow and the mare.
tuan: The Clinging means dependence. The sun and moon cling to heaven; the grains, plants, and trees cling to the earth. Double brightness clings to what is correct, and thereby transforms and perfects all under heaven. The yielding clings to central and correct positions, thus bringing success. It brings success to nurture the cow and the mare because of this.
daxiang: That which is bright rises twice: the image of the Clinging. Thus the great person continues the work of the past in illuminating all under the four quarters of heaven.

name: Influence
text: Influence. Success. Perseverance furthers. To take a maiden to wife brings good fortune.
tuan: Influence means stimulation. The yielding is above and the firm below; the two energies stimulate and unite with each other. Stillness and joy; the man submits to the woman. Thus success and perseverance bring good fortune, and taking a maiden to wife brings good fortune. Heaven and earth stimulate each other, and all things take form and come to life. The sage stimulates the hearts of men, and the world attains peace and rest. Observe the stimulation of heaven and earth, and the feelings of all beings become visible.
daxiang: A lake on the mountain: the image of Influence. Thus the superior person opens his heart to receive others.

name: Duration
text: Duration. Success. No blame. Perseverance furthers. It furthers one to have somewhere to go.
tuan: Duration means lasting. The firm is above and the yielding below; thunder and wind work together; gentle and moving, the firm and yielding all respond to each other. This is called Duration. Duration brings success without blame and perseverance furthers because it lasts in its way. The way of heaven and earth lasts forever and does not cease. It furthers one to have somewhere to go because the end brings a new beginning. The sun and moon shine in heaven and can last because they have heaven; the four seasons change and transform and can last in their achievements. The sage lasts in his way and the world is transformed and brought to completion. Observe what lasts, and the feelings of heaven and earth and all beings become visible.
daxiang: Thunder and wind: the image of Duration. Thus the superior person stands firm without changing his place.

name: Retreat
text: Retreat. Success. In small matters perseverance furthers.
tuan: Retreat brings success because it is timely. The firm occupies the proper place and responds, acting in accordance with the time. In small matters perseverance furthers because what is small is gradually growing. Great indeed is the significance of the time of Retreat.
daxiang: Under heaven is the mountain: the image of Retreat. Thus the superior person keeps the inferior at a distance, not with severity but with reserve.

name: The Power of the Great
text: The Power of the Great. Perseverance furthers.
tuan: The Power of the Great means the great are strong. Because it is firm it moves; thus it is called the Power of the Great. The Power of the Great brings perseverance and furthers because the great are correct. When the great are correct, the feelings of heaven and earth become visible.
daxiang: Thunder in heaven above: the image of the Power of the Great. Thus the superior person does not tread upon paths that do not accord with established usages.

name: Progress
text: Progress. The powerful prince is honored with horses in large numbers. In a single day he is granted audience three times.
tuan: Progress means advance. Brightness rises out of the earth; gentleness and cleaving to the great light, the yielding advances upward. Thus the powerful prince is honored with horses in large numbers, and in a single day is granted audience three times.
daxiang: The sun rises above the earth: the image of Progress. Thus the superior person makes himself bright and clear within.

name: Darkening of the Light
text: Darkening of the Light. It is favorable to suffer hardship with perseverance.
tuan: Brightness enters the earth: this is Darkening of the Light. Cultivated inside and yielding outside, one uses this to endure great hardship. This was King Wen. Favorable to suffer hardship with perseverance means to hide one's light in hardship, enduring inner difficulty while maintaining one's purpose. This was the Viscount of Ji.
daxiang: Brightness enters the earth: the image of Darkening of the Light. Thus the superior person governs the multitude by obscuring his light, using obscurity to achieve clarity.

name: The Family
text: The Family. The perseverance of the woman furthers.
tuan: In the Family, the woman occupies her proper place within and the man his proper place without. Man and woman in their proper places: this is the great righteousness of heaven and earth. In the Family there is a stern ruler, meaning the parents. When the father is father and the son is son, the elder brother elder brother and the younger brother younger brother, the husband husband and the wife wife, then the way of the Family is correct. When the Family is correct, the world is established.
daxiang: Wind comes forth from fire: the image of the Family. Thus the superior person is careful in his words and consistent in his actions.

name: Opposition
text: Opposition. In small matters good fortune.
tuan: Opposition: fire moves upward, the lake moves downward. Two women dwell together but their wills do not flow together. Joy and cleaving to brightness; the yielding advances upward, occupying the center and responding to the firm: thus there is good fortune in small matters. Heaven and earth are opposite but their affairs are the same. Man and woman are opposite but their wills strive together. All beings are opposite but their affairs are alike. Great indeed is the use of the time of Opposition.
daxiang: Fire above, the lake below: the image of Opposition. Thus the superior person seeks common ground while preserving differences.

name: Obstruction
text: Obstruction. It is favorable to go southwest; it is not favorable to go northeast. It furthers one to see the great person. Perseverance brings good fortune.
tuan: Obstruction means difficulty; danger lies ahead. Seeing danger and being able to stop is wisdom. Obstruction: it is favorable to go southwest because going gains the center. It is not favorable to go northeast because the way is exhausted. It furthers one to see the great person because going brings success. Perseverance brings good fortune because it corrects the country. Great indeed is the use of the time of Obstruction.
daxiang: Water upon the mountain: the image of Obstruction. Thus the superior person turns inward and cultivates his virtue.

name: Deliverance
text: Deliverance. The southwest furthers. If there is nothing to go to, returning brings good fortune. If there is something to go to, early departure brings good fortune.
tuan: Deliverance: danger moves, and movement brings release from danger. Deliverance: the southwest furthers because going gains the multitude. Returning brings good fortune because one gains the center. Early departure brings good fortune because going brings success. When heaven and earth are delivered, thunder and rain set in. When thunder and rain set in, all seeds and plants burst their husks. Great indeed is the time of Deliverance.
daxiang: Thunder and rain bring deliverance: the image of Deliverance. Thus the superior person forgives faults and pardons crimes.

name: Decrease
text: Decrease combined with sincerity brings supreme success. No blame. One may be persevering in this. It furthers one to undertake something. How is this to be carried out? One may use two small bowls for the sacrifice.
tuan: Decrease: what is below is diminished, and the way is to act above. Decrease combined with sincerity brings supreme success, no blame, perseverance furthers, and it furthers one to undertake something. How is this to be carried out? Two small bowls may be used for the sacrifice, responding to the time. Decreasing the firm and increasing the yielding must have its time. Decrease and increase, fullness and emptiness, go with the time.
daxiang: At the foot of the mountain is the lake: the image of Decrease. Thus the superior person controls his anger and restrains his desires.

name: Increase
text: Increase. It furthers one to undertake something. It furthers one to cross the great water.
tuan: Increase: what is above is increased, and the people rejoice without limit. What comes from above to be given below is the way of greatness. It furthers one to undertake something because the central and correct brings blessing. It furthers one to cross the great water because the way of wood brings success. Increase moves and is gentle, daily advancing without limit. Heaven bestows, earth produces, and the increase is boundless. In all ways of increase, it goes with the time.
daxiang: Wind and thunder: the image of Increase. Thus the superior person, when he sees good, hastens to emulate it; when he has faults, he hastens to correct them.

name: Breakthrough
text: Breakthrough. One must resolutely proclaim the truth in the royal court, announcing it with a cry that must be full of danger. Informing one's own city, it is not favorable to resort to arms. It furthers one to undertake something.
tuan: Breakthrough means resolution: the firm resolves the yielding. Strength and joy, resolving and harmonizing. One must resolutely proclaim the truth in the royal court because the yielding rides on five firms. Announcing it with a cry full of danger brings light because there is danger. Informing one's own city, it is not favorable to resort to arms because what is held in high esteem is brought to an end. It furthers one to undertake something because the firm grows and finally prevails.
daxiang: The lake has risen to heaven: the image of Breakthrough. Thus the superior person bestows bounty on those below him, but does not sit in judgment on his virtue.

name: Coming to Meet
text: Coming to Meet. The maiden is powerful. One should not marry such a maiden.
tuan: Coming to Meet means meeting: the yielding meets the firm. One should not marry such a maiden because one cannot live with her long. Heaven and earth meet, and all beings come into full flower. The firm meets the central and correct, and all under heaven act with great success. Great indeed is the significance of the time of Coming to Meet.
daxiang: Under heaven the wind blows: the image of Coming to Meet. Thus the ruler proclaims his commands to the four quarters of heaven.

name: Gathering Together
text: Gathering Together. Success. The king approaches his temple. It furthers one to see the great person. This brings success. Perseverance furthers. To use great sacrifices is favorable. It furthers one to undertake something.
tuan: Gathering Together means assembly. Gentleness and joy; the firm is in the center and responds: thus assembly is achieved. The king approaches his temple, offering reverence to the supreme deity. It furthers one to see the great person, bringing success, because one acts correctly in assembly. To use great sacrifices is favorable, and it furthers one to undertake something because one responds to the mandate of heaven. Observe what is assembled, and the feelings of heaven and earth and all beings become visible.
daxiang: The lake is on the earth: the image of Gathering Together. Thus the superior person readies his weapons of war and guards against the unexpected.

name: Pushing Upward
text: Pushing Upward has supreme success. One must see the great person; do not be anxious. Advance to the south brings good fortune.
tuan: The yielding advances upward according to the time; gentle and yielding, the firm is in the center and responds: thus there is great success. One must see the great person; do not be anxious, because there is blessing. Advance to the south brings good fortune because the will is carried out.
daxiang: Within the earth wood grows: the image of Pushing Upward. Thus the superior person, by cultivating obedience, attains greatness from small beginnings.

name: Oppression
text: Oppression. Success. Perseverance. The great person brings good fortune. No blame. When one has something to say, it is not believed.
tuan: Oppression: the firm is concealed. Danger and joy, oppressed yet not losing its way to success, this is only the superior person. Perseverance: the great person brings good fortune because the firm is in the center. When one has something to say and it is not believed, one esteems empty talk and reaches an impasse.
daxiang: The lake has no water: the image of Oppression. Thus the superior person stakes his life on following his will.

name: The Well
text: The Well. The town may be changed, but the well cannot be changed. It neither decreases nor increases. They come and go and draw from the well. If the water is clear and there is no rope, or if one breaks one's water pitcher, misfortune.
tuan: Gentleness within water makes the Well. The Well nourishes without ceasing. The town may be changed but the well cannot be changed because of the firm in the center. If the water is clear and there is no rope, or if one breaks one's water pitcher, there is misfortune because one has accomplished nothing. The water pitcher broken means misfortune.
daxiang: Wood in the water brings the Well: the image of the Well. Thus the superior person encourages the people to help one another.

name: Revolution
text: Revolution. On your own day you are believed. Supreme success. Furthering through perseverance. Remorse disappears.
tuan: Revolution: water and fire annihilate each other. Two women dwell together, but their wills do not flow together. On your own day you are believed: revolution brings trust. Clarity and joy bring great success through perseverance. When revolution is right, remorse disappears. Heaven and earth bring about revolution, and the four seasons are completed. Tang and Wu brought about revolution, obeying heaven and responding to the people. Great indeed is the time of Revolution.
daxiang: Fire in the lake: the image of Revolution. Thus the superior person governs the calendar and makes the seasons clear.

name: The Cauldron
text: The Cauldron. Supreme good fortune. Success.
tuan: The Cauldron is the image. Wood penetrates fire, and the cauldron stands ready. The sage prepares the cauldron to offer to God, and the great persons prepare it to nourish the wise and good. Gentleness and eyes and ears clear and bright; the yielding advances upward, occupying the center and responding to the firm: thus there is great success.
daxiang: Fire over wood: the image of the Cauldron. Thus the superior person consolidates his destiny by establishing his position.

name: The Arousing
text: The Arousing brings success. When the Arousing comes, one laughs and talks cheerfully. Arousing terrifies for a hundred miles, but one does not let the sacrificial spoon and chalice drop.
tuan: The Arousing brings success. When the Arousing comes, fear brings good fortune. Laughing and talking cheerfully, there are rules afterward. Arousing terrifies for a hundred miles, frightening the distant and the near. One may go out to preserve the ancestral temple and the state, and act as the master of the sacrifice.
daxiang: Thunder repeated: the image of the Arousing. Thus the superior person in fear and trembling sets himself in order and examines himself.

name: The Keeping Still
text: The Keeping Still. When one keeps his back still, he no longer feels his body. He walks in his courtyard and does not see his people. No blame.
tuan: Keeping Still means stopping. When it is time to stop, one stops; when it is time to move, one moves. Movement and rest do not miss the right time; one's path is bright and clear. Keeping Still in one's place: above and below do not respond to each other, and do not unite. Thus one does not feel his body, and walking in the courtyard, does not see the people: no blame.
daxiang: Mountain doubled: the image of Keeping Still. Thus the superior person does not permit his thoughts to go beyond his place.

name: Development
text: Development. The maiden is given in marriage. Good fortune. Perseverance furthers.
tuan: Development means gradual progress. The maiden is given in marriage in good fortune because she advances by obtaining her proper place. Going forward brings success because one goes with what is correct. Going can correct the country. In her place, the firm obtains the center. Keeping still and gentle, movement never ends.
daxiang: On the mountain is a tree: the image of Development. Thus the superior person abides in virtue and improves the manners of the people.

name: The Marrying Maiden
text: The Marrying Maiden brings misfortune. Nothing that would further.
tuan: The Marrying Maiden is the great righteousness of heaven and earth. If heaven and earth do not unite, all beings do not flourish. The Marrying Maiden is the beginning and end of human beings. Joy and movement: what is married off is the maiden. Going brings misfortune because the places are not correct. Nothing that would further: the yielding rides on the firm.
daxiang: Thunder over the lake: the image of the Marrying Maiden. Thus the superior person understands the transitory in the light of the eternal.

name: Abundance
text: Abundance has success. The king approaches his temple. It furthers one not to be anxious. It is favorable to be at midday.
tuan: Abundance means greatness. Clarity and movement bring abundance. The king approaches his temple; esteeming greatness, one is not anxious. It is favorable to be at midday because it should illumine all under heaven. When the sun stands at midday, it begins to set; when the moon is full, it begins to wane. Heaven and earth in their fullness and emptiness wax and wane with the time. How much more is this true of humans and spirits!
daxiang: Thunder and lightning come together: the image of Abundance. Thus the superior person decides lawsuits and executes punishments.

name: The Wanderer
text: The Wanderer. Success through smallness. Perseverance brings good fortune to the wanderer.
tuan: The Wanderer brings small success. The yielding occupies the outer position and obeys the firm; keeping still and cleaving to brightness, thus there is small success and perseverance brings good fortune to the wanderer. Great indeed is the significance of the time of the Wanderer.
daxiang: Fire on the mountain: the image of the Wanderer. Thus the superior person is clear-minded and cautious in meting out punishments and does not delay in legal proceedings.

name: The Gentle
text: The Gentle. Small success. It furthers one to have somewhere to go. It furthers one to see the great person.
tuan: Gentleness repeated makes one resolute in commands. The firm is gentle in the central and correct and its will is carried out. The yielding all obey the firm: thus there is small success and it furthers one to have somewhere to go and to see the great person.
daxiang: Gentleness following the wind: the image of the Gentle. Thus the superior person reiterates his orders and carries out his affairs.

name: The Joyous
text: The Joyous. Success. Perseverance furthers.
tuan: The Joyous means joy. The firm is in the middle and the yielding outside; joy and perseverance bring success because it accords with heaven and responds to human beings. Joy before the people: the people forget their toil. Joy in meeting hardship: the people forget their death. Great indeed is the use of the Joyous; the people are encouraged.
daxiang: Lakes resting on one another: the image of the Joyous. Thus the superior person joins with friends for discussion and practice.

name: Dispersion
text: Dispersion. Success. The king approaches his temple. It furthers one to cross the great water. Perseverance furthers.
tuan: Dispersion brings success because the firm comes and does not exhaust itself; the yielding occupies the proper place outside and unites with what is above. The king approaches his temple because the king is in the center. It furthers one to cross the great water because riding on wood brings success.
daxiang: The wind drives over the water: the image of Dispersion. Thus the ancient kings offered sacrifice to God and established the temple of the ancestors.

name: Limitation
text: Limitation. Success. Bitter limitation does not further.
tuan: Limitation brings success because the firm and yielding are divided and the firm occupies the center. Bitter limitation does not further because its way is exhausted. Joy in overcoming danger, the proper place for limitation: the central and correct brings success. Heaven and earth are limited, and the four seasons are formed. Limitation is used to establish number and measure, sparing property and people.
daxiang: Water over the lake: the image of Limitation. Thus the superior person establishes number and measure, and discusses virtue and conduct.

name: Inner Truth
text: Inner Truth. Pigs and fish. Good fortune. It furthers one to cross the great water. Perseverance furthers.
tuan: Inner Truth: the yielding is within and the firm occupies the center; joy and gentleness: trust transforms the country. Pigs and fish bring good fortune because trust reaches pigs and fish. It furthers one to cross the great water because riding in an empty wooden boat brings success. Inner Truth and perseverance furthers because it responds to heaven.
daxiang: Wind over the lake: the image of Inner Truth. Thus the superior person discusses criminal cases and delays executions.

name: Preponderance of the Small
text: Preponderance of the Small. Success. Perseverance furthers. Small matters may be undertaken; great matters should not. The bird leaves its sound in the sky; it is not favorable to soar upward, but favorable to descend. Great good fortune.
tuan: Preponderance of the Small: what is small passes and brings success. Passing and perseverance furthers because it goes with the time. The yielding occupies the center: thus there is good fortune in small matters. The firm is not in its place and not in the center: thus great matters should not be undertaken. There is the image of a flying bird. The bird leaves its sound in the sky; it is not favorable to soar upward but favorable to descend: great good fortune, because soaring upward means going against what is below, while descending means following it.
daxiang: Thunder on the mountain: the image of Preponderance of the Small. Thus the superior person exceeds in courtesy, exceeds in sorrow, exceeds in economy.

name: After Completion
text: After Completion. Success in small matters. Perseverance furthers. At the beginning good fortune, at the end confusion.
tuan: After Completion brings success because the yielding is in the center. Small success at the beginning because the yielding is in the middle. At the end confusion because the way is exhausted. Although they are not in their proper places, the firm and yielding correspond to each other.
daxiang: Water over fire: the image of After Completion. Thus the superior person takes precautions against trouble and prepares for the unexpected.

name: Before Completion
text: Before Completion. Success. The little fox is almost across the river, but its tail gets wet. Nothing that would further.
tuan: Before Completion brings success because the yielding is in the center. The little fox is almost across but has not yet emerged from the river. Its tail gets wet: nothing that would further, because it does not continue to the end. Although they are not in their proper places, the firm and yielding correspond to each other.
daxiang: Fire over water: the image of Before Completion. Thus the superior person is careful in distinguishing things, that he may set each in its proper place.
